source_description: Absorb 5% of hostile spells while wielding a staff, and convert absorbed magicka to staff charge.
target_description: 手持法杖時，有 5% 機率吸收敵對法術，並將吸收的法力轉化為法杖充能。

source_description: Reflect hostile spells you would absorb when at full magicka and staff charge.
target_description: 法力與法杖充能全滿時，反射原本會被你吸收的敵對法術。

source_description: 50% chance to dodge incoming arrows while sprinting.
target_description: 衝刺時有 50% 機率閃避來襲的箭矢。

source_description: Unarmed attacks with gauntlets do bonus damage based on their temper quality.
target_description: 戴著護手進行徒手攻擊時，依護手的鍛造品質造成額外傷害。

source_description: Unarmed attacks do twice as much damage.
Dual unarmed attacks are an additional 15% faster.
target_description: 雙手徒手攻擊速度額外提升 15%。

source_description: 30% reduced damage from elemental effects while focusing a staff.
target_description: 蓄力施放法杖時，受到的元素效果傷害降低 30%。

source_description: Unarmed left or right power attacks have a 25% chance to knock down opponents.
target_description: 左手或右手的徒手強力攻擊有 25% 機率擊倒對手。

source_description: Time slows down when an enemy attack would be lethal.
target_description: 當敵人的一次攻擊足以致命時，時間流逝速度減慢。

source_description: 50% less stagger while focusing a staff.
target_description: 蓄力施放法杖時，受到的失衡效果降低 50%。

source_description: Unarmed attacks do more damage when your health is low.
target_description: 生命偏低時，徒手攻擊造成更多傷害。

source_description: Stamina regenerates 10 times faster out of combat.
target_description: 非戰鬥狀態下，耐力恢復速度變為 10 倍。

source_description: Completely restore stamina when entering combat.
target_description: 進入戰鬥時完全恢復耐力。

source_description: Dual unarmed power attacks are 50% stronger.
target_description: 雙手徒手強力攻擊傷害提升 50%。

source_description: 20% resistance to frost damage and +10 warmth rating.
target_description: 寒霜傷害抗性提升 20%，保暖值提高 10 點。

source_description: Unarmed combination power attacks cause increasing stagger on successive hits.
target_description: 徒手組合強力攻擊連續命中時，造成的失衡逐次提高。

source_description: Unarmed attacks briefly reduce the opponent's attack damage by 5%.
target_description: 徒手攻擊會短暫降低對手 5% 的攻擊傷害。

source_description: Unarmed attacks briefly reduce the opponent's attack damage by 10%.
target_description: 徒手攻擊會短暫降低對手 10% 的攻擊傷害。

source_description: Magicka regenerates 50% faster while wielding a staff.
target_description: 手持法杖時，法力恢復速度提升 50%。

source_description: 35% resistance to frost damage and +20 warmth rating.
target_description: 寒霜傷害抗性提升 35%，保暖值提高 20 點。
